shipwreck.name: Shipwreck
shipwreck.description: A sunken pirate ship where Alden discovers the first hint of the hidden treasure.

village.name: The Village
village.description: A small fishing village near the shore.
village.image_prompt: cozy little fishing village, summer scene

treasure_chest.name: Treasure Chest
treasure_chest.description: A chest that Alden finds at the bottom of a sunken pirate ship. Inside it are mysterious objects and clues.
treasure_chest.image_prompt: wooden treasure chest, pirate map inside

hero.name: Alden
hero.description: A brave young adventurer in search of the hidden treasure.

pirate_captain.name: Captain Blackbeard
pirate_captain.description: The pirate captain who built this ship and hid a treasure inside it. He now guards his secret.
pirate_captain.image_prompt: dangerous pirate with black beard, pirate ship

dialogues.before_talk: Captain: I have something for you that belongs to the village. But remember, only one can touch this chest... and die a hero or a traitor.
dialogues.after_talk: Captain: You will need more courage than anyone in the world to get it out of me.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Captain: Very well, my treasure is yours now, but be ready for its power.
dialogues.hostile: Captain: What do you think you are doing? Get back before I punish you!
